skillset.truearts:
21000% Fire DMG (MAG). For 15s, increase Allies' Arts by 3/s, heal Allies' HP by 120/s. When there are 10 Spirit Foxes: 21000% Fire DMG (MAG). Reduce # of Spirit Foxes by 5 + Increase Allies' Arts by 100 + For 15s, increase Allies' Arts by 3/s, heal Allies' HP by 120/s.
